answer: The arXiv ASTRO-PH network (SNAP's ca-AstroPh collaboration network) is a co-authorship network. Each node represents an author who has posted at least one paper in the arXiv Astrophysics (astro-ph) category. Each undirected edge connects two authors who have co-authored at least one paper together. The network contains 18,772 nodes and 198,110 edges. It covers papers from January 1993 to April 2003.
